name: Sanriku (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Sanriku town emblem in white: two concentric outlined arcs with three horizontal strokes, like a letter E.
history: Flag of the former town of Sanriku in Iwate Prefecture, dissolved on 2001-11-15. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 October 1958.

features.role: Sanriku town emblem — two concentric outlined arcs with three horizontal strokes, like a letter E
